points.description: Defines classification as mapping data/inputs to discrete labels (categories/classes) and regression as mapping data/inputs to continuous values (real-valued outputs/function). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two (classification or regression) is correctly defined, or if the discrete vs continuous distinction is stated without tying each to its task.

points.description: States how error differs: in classification error is the number (count) of misclassifications; in regression error is the summed distance/difference between true and predicted values (e.g. sum of absolute or squared errors).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two error measures is correctly given.
